package repro

// Unrelated declarations are removable noise.
type Metadata struct { Label string }

func unrelated(value int) int {
    if value > 0 { return value + 1 }
    return 0
}

type State struct { Count int }

// A conditional assignment must not erase the parameter boundary.
func Mutate(shared *State) {
    scratch := []int{1, 2, 3}; _ = scratch
    closure := func(value *State) {
        if false { value = new(State) }
        value.Count++
    }
    closure(shared)
}

func anotherUnrelated() string {
    return "noise"
}
